section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 18, Skekarsbo-Gysinge
section.notes: Project/Upplandsstiftelsen heading sometimes says Gysinge-Skekarsbo, but the official route fields and Naturkartan title say Start: Skekarsbo, Slut: Gysinge. Treat as a western branch/anslutning, not continuous from Etapp 17.

interSegmentGaps.note: Kungsgårds fäbod spur returns to the main line. Preserve segments and do not draw a false connector.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan anslutning 18 GPX as primary geometry.
The official GPX direction is Skekarsbo-to-Gysinge.
Preserve the official multi-segment geometry; Långvindsängena and Kungsgårds fäbod are spur/side segments.
Do not auto-connect the 560 m intersegment gap after the Kungsgårds fäbod spur.
qa: The plain upplan dsleden-etapp-18 Naturkartan slug returns 404/500 for GPX; use upplandsleden-anslutning-18 and its GPX.
Etapp 18 is a separate western branch and is not continuous from Etapp 17/Långhäll.
Etapp 19 handoff is exact at Skekarsbo, but Etapp 19 is stored Nora/Tärnsjö-to-Skekarsbo while Etapp 18 starts at Skekarsbo.
Gysinge connects near-continuously to Gästrikeleden route geometry.

suppressions.name: Busshållplats, Gysinge brukshandel

suppressions.name: Färnebofjärden national park rules
suppressions.notes: National park-wide rules/context: camp only at designated places, fire only at designated fire areas, dogs leashed, do not damage vegetation/trees, and some areas have access bans Jan 1-Jul 31. Do not infer campsite rows from ordinary shelter rows.

suppressions.name: Gysinge nature reserve rules
suppressions.notes: Reserve context on/near Mattön and Gysinge: fires only at prepared rest areas, dogs leashed, no camping on Granön/Åsbyvallen, and no wood/plant collection. Some parts can be wet in spring/autumn.

suppressions.name: Gysinge commercial services
suppressions.notes: Gysinge has hostel/hotel, cafe, restaurant and shops, but current commercial opening-hour rows are not modeled here. Naturum and year-round water are represented separately.

suppressions.name: Tyttbo/Färnebofjärden broader park leakage
suppressions.notes: Tyttbo and broader national-park attractions are not Etapp 18 route points. Suppress unless a route-specific object is verified.

suppressions.name: Gästrikeleden connection at Gysinge
suppressions.notes: Onward route connection only. Etapp 18 endpoint is within a few metres of Gästrikeleden geometry at Gysinge.

suppressions.name: Etapp 19 leakage
suppressions.notes: Suppress Etapp 19-specific rows except shared Skekarsbo endpoint context. Do not import Nordmyran, Messkog, Österbo fäbodar or Nora kyrka/Tärnsjö water/transit into Etapp 18.

decisions.dedupePolicy: Dedupe shared Skekarsbo endpoint context with Etapp 19. Preserve side-spur geometry for Långvindsängena and Kungsgårds fäbod. Keep national-park/reserve rules as metadata and never infer tent/campsite rows from ordinary shelter rows in Färnebofjärden.

iterationLog.focus: First batch pass for Etapp 18 using Naturkartan anslutning 18, Upplandsstiftelsen, GPX/spur QA, Färnebofjärden/Gysinge rule sources, Naturkartan object pages and route-connection review.
iterationLog.result: Created standalone Etapp 18 research file. Normal imports cover Skekarsbo, Brattnäset, Kallviken, Långvindsängena, Kungsgårds fäbod, Sevedskvarn, Mattön, Norra Mattön, Gysinge water, Naturum Färnebofjärden and Gysinge bruk. Skekarsboberget side trip and Långvindsängena charcoal remains remain pending. Access rows, rules/context, commercial services, Tyttbo leakage, Gästrikeleden connection and Etapp 19 leakage are metadata-only or suppressed.
